schema: §2.7 (v0.50) -- complete per-sentence segment disposition, superseding §21 R6's not_annotatable-only shape. `not_annotatable` (R6's original array, the only key run_scoring.load_not_annotatable() reads) is preserved for scoring and holds every NOT_OBLIGATION_BEARING / NOT_ANNOTATABLE / EXCLUDED span. `dispositions` is the full per-sentence record §2.7 requires, covering ANNOTATED and AMBIGUOUS spans too, which `not_annotatable` deliberately excludes -- an AMBIGUOUS span is an open reviewer question, not a settled non-item, and including it in the scoring array would resolve it silently.

reconciliation.note: 3 obligation-bearing clauses vs 1 items_annotated. 1 span(s) AMBIGUOUS, escalated per §14.3/§14.4 rather than resolved silently. Gap fully explained by recorded dispositions (nothing uncovered); resolution is a reviewer decision, not taken here.

dispositions.span_text: Provider and Recipient shall each use its commercially reasonable efforts consistent with its past practices to prevent the introduction or coding of viruses or similar items into the Systems of the other Party.

Without limiting the rights and remedies of any party hereunder, in the event a virus or similar item is introduced into the Systems of a Party, whether or not such introduction is attributable to the other Party (including such other Party's failure to perform its obligations under this Agreement), the other Party shall, as soon as practicable, use its commercially reasonable efforts to assist such Party in reducing the effects of the virus or similar item, and if the virus or similar item causes a loss of operational efficiency or loss of data, upon such Party's request, work as soon as practicable to contain and remedy the problem and to restore lost data resulting from such introduction.
dispositions.rule: no identifiable exclusion rule, plus an open §4.3 splitting question — SPLITTING_EXCLUSION_INVESTIGATION.md Category A, rows 4-5
dispositions.reason: Surplus clauses #4/#5, one sentence at this project's sentence-granularity but split by the cold annotator into two independently-breachable duties ('...use its commercially reasonable efforts to assist...' / '...work as soon as practicable to contain and remedy the problem...'), each gated by different circumstances. §2.7's unit is the sentence, so this is one disposition entry representing two candidate obligation-bearing clauses for reconciliation purposes.

readings.reading: Two genuine MUST items, split under §4.3 (best attempt)
readings.detail: Assisting and remediating are gated by different circumstances (the second needs an actual loss AND a request) and are independently breachable -- the cold annotator's own §4.3 analysis. §3.1's minimal-complete-span excludes the 'Without limiting the rights and remedies' savings opener under §3.8.1's not-branch-1 class.
No gold-side record of any kind exists for either half; the investigation found this splitting decision unopposed rather than disputed, since gold produced zero items here to compare against.
